# dsh-workbench
A workbench for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: one sidebar entry that brings local Git, GitLab M
Rs / GitHub PRs and their Issues, Aliyun DMS ticket approvals, Aliyun SLS log queries, PingCode work
items and skills management into a single panel — driven entirely by the CLIs already installed and
logged in on your machine.
The plugin is a static bundle: the host half registers same-origin routes that run local CLIs, and t
he client half renders the panel inside DSH. It stores no credentials and does not interfere with yo
ur sessions — no dynamic runner, no approval, no steering.
## Screenshots

## Features
### Workbench
| Page | What you get |
| Home | Default landing page: cross-workspace sessions that need your attention (running / pending
/ active in the last 24 h), stat cards for running sessions, MRs awaiting review, pending DMS approv

als and unread GitHub notifications, plus the latest unread notifications. |
| Repository | One page
with a **Git \| MR/PR \| Issues \| Auto-review** sub-navigation; workspace and platform are detecte

d automatically from the Git remote. |
| Git | Local changes (staged / unstaged / conflicts) with di
ff preview, staging, commit (including AI-generated commit messages with a configurable model and la
nguage), history graph with search, branches / tags / remotes, checkout, create / rename / delete br

anch, merge, pull (fast-forward only), push (never force) and commit-and-push. |
| MR / PR | My / To
review / All lists, detail with the full diff, one-click AI review in a fresh session, per-reposito
ry background auto-review, approve, merge (optionally squash / delete the source branch), comment, c

lose and open in the browser. |
| Issues | Whole-repository issue list with search, labels, assignee
, state, sort and pagination; detail with comments and related MRs; edit; batch close / reopen; "Han

dle" starts a fresh session that analyses the issue first. |
| Assistant message actions | "Submit M
R/PR" on a finalized assistant message creates the MR/PR in the current session; "Git" opens the com

mit dialog for the workspace. |
| Notifications | GitHub unread notifications across repositories; o
pening one marks it read and links to GitHub. The list has no top-level tab — the Home page is its e

ntry point. |
| Skills | Browse installed skills from DSH's skill roots, read SKILL.md and reference
d support files (highlighted code, CSV tables, images), enable / disable, uninstall, check for updat

es; search skills.sh and install with one click. |
| Settings | Per-user feature toggles, sidebar sh
ortcut selection, review model, Git commit language, and editable prompts for review, Issue handling
, Git commits and MR/PR submission. |
[该节后续省略]
### Optional integrations
Nothing below is required to install or use the workbench. Each integration is only contacted while
the corresponding page or action is used; a missing CLI shows an in-page hint instead of breaking th
e rest of the panel.
| Integration | Powers | Requires |
| GitLab / GitHub | Repository MR/PR, Issues, auto-review, GitHub notifications | `glab` and / or `g
h` installed and logged in; network access to the instance. A self-hosted GitLab must be known to `g

lab auth status`. |
| Aliyun DMS | Ticket approval, order detail and SQL | `aliyun` CLI logged in; R
AM read + approval permissions. Region (and `Tid` for multi-tenant accounts) can be set in the page.

|
| Aliyun SLS | Log and trace queries, SQL / JSON detail, trace drill-down and waterfall | `aliyun
` CLI logged in; RAM log-read permission; target Project / Logstore with indexes configured; `slsEnv
ironments` set in the plugin row config (no default project). Aliyun service — available in supporte

d Aliyun regions. |
| PingCode | Read-only work items, comments and filters | `python3` plus a local

`pingcode` skill directory containing `scripts/api_call.py` and a configured `.env`. |
| skills.sh
| Install / update / discover skills | `node` + `npx` (first run fetches the skills package over the
network). Listing and previewing local skills works without it. |
## Requirements & compatibility
- **DSH**: tested against the `0.2.2-rc.1` desktop app; the plugin is built against the public `@dee
pseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-*` `0.1.6-alpha.2` contract packages. Newer versions may work, but DSH UI ext

ension points can change.
- **OS**: macOS and Linux are the tested targets; Windows is untested.
- *
*Node.js**: not required to use the plugin (the client and host bundles are prebuilt). Development n
eeds Node.js `>= 22.15.0`; the Skills page's install / update / search needs a local Node.js with `n

px` (the project's tested baseline is `22.15.0`).
- **CLIs**: needed only for the optional integrati

ons above — each must be installed and logged in with your own account.
- **Tests**: the development
test suite is POSIX-only (it relies on `chmod` and symlinks), so development on Windows is not supp
suite is POSIX-only (it relies on `chmod` and symlinks), so development on Windows is not supported.
## Security & privacy
- **No credentials are stored.** The plugin reads data through the CLIs you already logged in (`git`
, `glab`, `gh`, `aliyun`, `npx skills`) and, for PingCode, through that skill's own `.env`. It never

persists tokens.
- **Same-origin routes.** Everything is registered on DSH's own web server behind

DSH's Host / Origin + login-cookie trust fence; the plugin opens no new port or listener.
- **Truste
d static client code.** The client bundle runs without per-action approval — install only packages y

ou trust.
- **Do not expose the DSH Web UI to untrusted networks.** Anyone who can load the page can

drive the local CLIs through it with your logged-in permissions.
- **Real writes happen only when y
ou trigger them**: DMS approvals, Git pushes, MR/PR merges / closes / comments, skill install / unin

stall and edits to skill files.
- The Home page reads DSH's own session storage files. That format i
s not an official contract; parsing failures degrade gracefully instead of breaking the page.
See SECURITY.md for how to report vulnerabilities.
